result.title: Space-X: Self-Evolving Spatial Agents Weaving Clues into Evidence Chains
result.summary: Spatial reasoning connects visual observations, geometric estimates, and linguistic decisions into a coherent derivation. Yet tool-augmented agents often acquire evidence without clear targets, combine outputs under inconsistent object or reference-frame semantics, and misjudge evidence sufficiency. Thus, more tools or calls do not reliably improve reasoning. We introduce Space-X, a spatial-reasoning framework that self-evolves toward complete, continuous evidence-chain construction. An Execution Agent acquires, associates, and judges evidence per problem using role-specific memory. A Control Agent diagnoses evidence-chain breaks from execution traces and jointly revises tools, interfaces, skills, memory organization, and decision rules. This loop co-evolves capability and evidence use: evidence needs guide capability development; usable results guide actions. Across multiple benchmarks, Space-X yields gains with four base models. Relative to baselines, GPT-6-sol improves answer accuracy on ViewSpatial and MMSI by 50.39% and 23.07%, respectively; Gemini-3.8-Flash gains 47.50% and 25.22% on these benchmarks. This provides a unified route from fragmented spatial clues to traceable, derivable answers.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Space-X 空间推理框架：执行智能体按题获取、关联并判断证据，控制智能体从执行轨迹诊断证据链断裂，联合修订工具、接口、技能、记忆组织与决策规则，在多个基准与四种基座上提升答案准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据充分性判断」与证据链断裂诊断直接对应 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡与视觉证据筛选问题，可作为工具型证据管理的对照；但未见内部 latent 状态的表示与使用，向 LVR 的迁移尚需核查。
